note: The Moose easter eggs, in one place so they are easy to audit and to add to each season. None of them changes a number or a rule: the rule book and the values in tables stay authoritative. Read by site/eggs.py.
antlers: Wherever the team appears in a table, an antler fades in above the name on hover.
title_watermark: The champion banner carries a moose watermark in the team's title seasons, whichever they are.

rivalry_captions.best: America's Team owns this one: {team} lead the series {w}-{l}.
rivalry_captions.losing: In fairness, {opp} have the Moose's number: {l}-{w} against them.

not_found.title: This page has been retained by the Moose
not_found.text: Whatever was here cost three retainment slots, and the Moose paid them.

museum.title: America's Team
museum.text: A franchise museum. There is no link to it, and the Moose would like it kept that way.

konami: Up up down down left right left right B A: the accent turns moose brown, the moose runs across the screen, and for a moment every team in the standings is the Moose. Picking the Moose in the trades page's team filter does the same. Arriving at the Moose's franchise page does too.

barney.what: Typing barney on any page turns the site purple, pops up F-Jackie's Barney logo for a few seconds, and renames F-Jackie to Barney in every table until he leaves. Script: site/assets/barney.js. The image is F-Jackie's MFL logo since 2019, from the original site's images/logos. Picking F-Jackie in the trades page's team filter calls him too. He also pops up on arrival at F-Jackie's franchise page.
barney.hint: Someone purple is never far away. Try typing his name.

clips.what: An inflatable tube man slides up in the corner and flails. Made from a GIF the commissioner supplied in 2026.
A rider on an electric scooter between two beer steins: don't drink and drive. Made from a GIF the commissioner supplied in 2026.

clips_note: Arriving at each team's franchise page, its clip slides up in the corner and plays for the seconds given (a click sends it off). Script: site/assets/clip.js, loaded on those pages only. Each clip is site/assets/<clip>.mp4, re-encoded from the GIF, with <clip>.jpg as its still for reduced motion.
